import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create an in-memory DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "city": ["New York", "London", "Paris"]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()

print(f"\nSerialized to {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(BytesIO(parquet_bytes))

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
assert df.equals(df_restored), "Round trip failed!"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful - DataFrames are identical")

import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create an in-memory DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "city": ["New York", "London", "Paris"]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()

print(f"\nSerialized to {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(BytesIO(parquet_bytes))

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
assert df.equals(df_restored), "Round trip failed!"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful - DataFrames are identical")
